full_name: Katherine Vaz | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Katherine Vaz, a Briggs-Copeland Fellow in Fiction at Harvard University, is the author of two novels, Mariana (HarperCollins/Flamingo, 1997), published in six languages and selected by the Library of Congress as one of the Top Thirty International Books of 1998, and Saudade (St. Martin’s Press, 1994), a Barnes & Noble Discover Great New Authors selection.
